title: Verify Mathar's recurrence for generalized-Stirling sequence A001711

source.citation: Tong Niu, A short proof of Mathar's 2020 recurrence conjecture for the generalized-Stirling sequence A001711, arXiv:2605.11351

translation.notes: Noether rationals evaluate the factorial–harmonic closed form exactly, reproduce the published OEIS prefix, and verify the conjectured recurrence on 499 indices.
